policy: Pinned snapshots copied into this repository. Nothing is imported from the reference repository at build time or runtime.

sources.used: Authored Case Pack shape: pack { id, name, nameEn, version, cases }; case { id, title, titleEn, recommendedEntry, indexDateTime, chiefComplaint, patient, persona { version, content }, visibleHistory, indexConditions, laboratories }; lab observation { id, codings, value, unit, unitDisplay, interpretation, referenceRange }.
patientPersonaContentSchema fields (chiefComplaint, openingStatement, knownHistorySummary, symptomExperience, medicationMemory, persona { character, speechStyle, healthLiteracy, attitude }).
Coding systems (ICD-10, LOINC 2.83, WS/T 886-2026) and the WBC, RBC, hemoglobin and platelet codings copied verbatim; visible-history medication entry style for amlodipine.

Golden Case 1 clinical content: patient, queue registration, allergy, chronic condition, visible history (with department), persona replies, Physical Examination findings, laboratory and imaging results, scripted Report amendments and debrief reference.

notes: The reference repository has no community-acquired pneumonia case at this commit, so Golden Case 1 is authored here following its schema.

Fields added beyond the reference schema, per the Phase 1 spec: registration, triage, allergies, chronicConditions, visibleHistory[].department, physicalExamination, laboratories[].catalogItem, textResults, reportAmendments, debriefReference.

Pack version 2026-11-24.2 adds the chronic problem list (chronicConditions) and the prior-visit department for the patient banner and its health-record popover, both taken from the prototype's HISTORY block; the department moved out of the 2015 visit's reasonText.

Pack version 2026-11-24.3 replaces triage.vitals with the prototype's pre-examination triage values (38.4 ℃, 98, 20, 136/82, SpO₂ 95 %) and adds triage.measuredAt from its "分诊 08:20" label. The earlier triage vitals equalled physicalExamination.vitals, which is Case Truth revealed only by the vitals Physical Examination, so showing them at triage leaked objective signs.

Pack version 2026-11-24.4 turns physicalExamination.vitals from the prototype's finding sentence into readings with the same fields as triage.vitals plus spo2Condition ("未吸氧"), so the vitals Physical Examination can update the banner tiles with flags; the values are unchanged and the finding sentence is rendered from them.

Pack version 2026-11-25.1 adds reportAmendments[].releaseAfterSeconds, the scripted delay after Report version 1 at which each amendment publishes as the next version (CBC 120 s, CRP 150 s, chest X-ray 180 s); the prototype published amendments from a demo button, so the delays are authored here.
Reference fields omitted as inpatient/PCI-specific: plannedStentCount, angiography, ttes, ecgs.
LOINC codings for neutrophil %, lymphocyte %, CRP and procalcitonin are authored here, not copied.
Case, patient and persona ids are diagnosis-neutral (golden-case-01, golden-patient-01) because they reach the browser; the reference repo's descriptive id style would leak Case Truth (ADR-0002).

Golden Case 4 (pack addition, 2026-11-25) is authored here as a synthetic, self-limiting viral URI case following the same schema; it exists only in this repository and validates the explicit No Medication conclusion. Its visibleHistory's prior J06.9 visit is authored chart noise (prior URI episodes are ordinary in outpatient records), not a leak of the hidden index condition.

Golden Case 2 (version 2026-11-25.2) adapts the reference case cardio-nstemi-chest-pain-v1 at commit 8d5b4069: patient, visible history, persona, the hs-cTnI values 0.68 → 1.45 ng/mL as the scripted Report amendment, and the initial ECG's V2–V5 ST depression. Inpatient/PCI-specific fields (plannedStentCount, angiography, ttes, repeat and follow-up stages) are omitted; disposition lives only in the debrief reference.

Golden Case 2 keeps the reference's diagnosis-neutrality where the browser sees it: queue 8, ids golden-case-02/golden-patient-02, persona and chief complaint name no diagnosis; NSTEMI stays in indexConditions and the debrief reference.

sources.used: :root and .dark color tokens (background through ring), --radius, --font-ui and --font-code fallbacks, and --clinmesh-glow.

notes: Light and dark values are folded into light-dark() pairs; the dsw design-system variable indirection is dropped and its fallback values kept.
Sidebar, chart and font-scale tokens are not copied yet.

sources.used: Reference ranges for WBC (3.5–9.5), platelets (125–350), random glucose (3.9–11.1) and HbA1c (4.0–6.0); hemoglobin, RBC and hematocrit ranges, which it marks as sex-dependent, are split by sex here.
CRP 0–8 mg/L, urine glucose 阴性, serum creatinine sex dependence and catalog turnaround minutes (CBC 20, CRP 30, HbA1c 120).

Healthy baseline values with their sex split (baselineLabs: wbc 6.4, hemoglobin 146/128, rbc 4.85/4.35, platelets 225, creatinine 82/68, urea 5.4, uric acid 350/290, ALT 24, AST 22, potassium 4.1, sodium 141, glucose 5.6, hs-cTnI 0.008, NT-proBNP 80, D-dimer 0.22).

Rule shape: a reference rule selected by sex with an 'all' fallback, and fixed normal values for qualitative results. The reference repo's seeded uniform generation is not used: baseline values are authored, never generated.
Catalog items, names, pinyin initials, specimens, departments, expected turnaround text, category stages and reporting staff names for 检验科 and 放射科.

notes: Every item carries age/sex-banded baseline rules; src/worker/investigation-catalog.ts admits only items whose bands cover both sexes from age 0 with normal baseline values.

Age bands for urea and creatinine (60+) and the sex-specific ranges for urea, creatinine, uric acid, ALT and AST follow WS/T 404 adult reference intervals; NT-proBNP age band (75+) and hs-cTnI sex-specific 99th percentiles, lipid targets, electrolytes, TBIL, ALB, urinalysis and influenza antigen ranges are authored here, not copied.
Imaging and ECG/echo baseline narratives are authored here.
simulatedTurnaroundSeconds is the simulation's shortened turnaround; expectedTurnaround is the clinic-facing text.

sources.used: Formulary rows (name, spec, package, units, class, pinyin initials, default dose/route/frequency/days) and the per-drug package-insert summaries (ind, contra, note), carried verbatim from the DRUGS block; the fixed cross-allergen reason list (OVERRIDE_REASONS).

notes: Insert summaries are synthetic prototype content pinned as-is; the provenance line 药品说明书摘要（合成） is shown with every summary.

Allergy rules live in code (src/shared/medication.ts): a recorded allergy to a drug class refuses every drug of that class; cephalosporin cross-reacts with penicillin allergy. Matching uses the recorded allergy's drugClass, never a drug code.
